# Get transactions for this month (May 2023)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
transactions = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if isinstance(result, dict) and 'message' in result:
        print("Error:", result)
        break
    transactions.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Number of transactions this month:", len(transactions))
print(transactions)
